res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/ArmorD.EquipPosition: Authored wearable position for this equipment item. Ring is eligible for Ring1 or Ring2; Trinket is eligible for Trinket1 or Trinket2. Character/class permission is validated separately.
res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/ArmorD.ArmorValue: Raw Armor contributed to the hero's resolved TotalArmor while this item is equipped. Stored and aggregated now; damage mitigation is intentionally not implemented yet.

res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/Shield.ArmorValue: Raw Armor contributed to the hero's resolved TotalArmor while this shield is equipped in Off Hand. Stored and aggregated now; damage mitigation is intentionally not implemented yet.

res://Controllers/CharacterWindowControl.Party: Runtime PartyController whose five authored party slots populate the Character Window hero selector.
res://Controllers/CharacterWindowControl.SelectedHeroLabel: Header label updated with the currently selected hero's real authored DisplayName. Level remains intentionally unbound until authoritative level data exists.
res://Controllers/CharacterWindowControl.PartySlot1Button: Clickable selector for authored party slot 1.
res://Controllers/CharacterWindowControl.PartySlot2Button: Clickable selector for authored party slot 2.
res://Controllers/CharacterWindowControl.PartySlot3Button: Clickable selector for authored party slot 3.
res://Controllers/CharacterWindowControl.PartySlot4Button: Clickable selector for authored party slot 4.
res://Controllers/CharacterWindowControl.PartySlot5Button: Clickable selector for authored party slot 5.
